question: Bleaching powder is prepared by the reaction of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**calcium hydroxide with chlorine gas**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Bleaching powder** is prepared by the action of **chlorine gas** on **dry slaked lime**, which is chemically known as **calcium hydroxide**. 
• The chemical reaction for this preparation is: **Ca(OH)2 + Cl2 → CaOCl2 + H2O**. This clearly shows that calcium hydroxide and chlorine are the necessary reactants. ***Hence, statement 3 is correct.*** 
• The reaction between **sodium hydroxide and chlorine gas** (Option 1) typically produces **sodium hypochlorite** (liquid bleach) and sodium chlorid
